import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from lib import *
def ST(off, h): return {"type": "STREAM", "id": 0, "offset": off, "data_hex": h, "fin": False}
def pk(level, pn, frames, auth=True): return {"level": level, "pn": pn, "auth": auth, "frames": frames}
def dg(t, size, packets): return {"t": t, "op": "datagram", "bytes": size, "packets": packets}

# E: install Z while early=false -> Z live, but Z packets still EARLY_REJECTED
evs = [{"t": 1, "op": "key", "level": "Z", "action": "install"},
       dg(2, 1200, [pk("Z", 0, [{"type": "PING"}])])]
print("E:", json.dumps(view(one(evs, early=False))))
# F: discard I then install I
evs = [{"t": 1, "op": "key", "level": "I", "action": "discard"},
       {"t": 2, "op": "key", "level": "I", "action": "install"},
       dg(3, 1200, [pk("I", 0, [{"type": "PING"}])])]
print("F:", json.dumps(view(one(evs))))
# G: live key never queues; discard H with pending, then install H (no-op)
evs = [dg(1, 1200, [pk("H", 0, [{"type": "PING"}])]),
       {"t": 2, "op": "key", "level": "H", "action": "discard"},
       {"t": 3, "op": "key", "level": "H", "action": "install"},
       dg(4, 1200, [pk("H", 1, [{"type": "PING"}])])]
print("G:", json.dumps(view(one(evs, buffer_packets=4))))
# H: ACK in an I packet uses sent.I only
evs = [{"t": 0, "op": "key", "level": "H", "action": "install"},
       dg(1, 1200, [pk("I", 0, [{"type": "ACK", "ranges": [[0, 1]]}])]),
       dg(2, 1200, [pk("H", 0, [{"type": "ACK", "ranges": [[0, 1]]}])])]
print("H:", json.dumps(view(one(evs, sent={"I": [[0, 1]], "H": [], "A": [[0, 1]]}))))
# I: stream count limit 0
print("I:", json.dumps(view(one([{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"},
    dg(1,1200,[pk("A",0,[ST(0,"aa")])])], max_streams_bidi=0))))
# J: max_data 0 with zero-length stream
print("J:", json.dumps(view(one([{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"},
    dg(1,1200,[pk("A",0,[ST(0,"")])])], max_data=0, max_stream_data=0))))
# K: offset within limit but max_stream_data=0
print("K:", json.dumps(view(one([{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"},
    dg(1,1200,[pk("A",0,ST and [ {"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aa","fin":False}])])],
    max_data=5, max_stream_data=0))))
